items.text: These notes provide advice on trading strategies, including deciding on exit levels, not averaging down entry, and considering the size of trades rather than timing. They also mention the importance of being aware of market trends and not getting caught up in the hype of new cryptocurrencies.
* Decide your exit by level, not hope.
Doing the right things consistently gives you a better chance.
